name: Rise | 1500mg Tincture | CBG
description: This CBG-only formulation helps to provide a non-euphoric experience of clarifying relaxation, mood-boosting, and improved gut health in a convenient tincture form. 1500mg CBG per bottle and is THC free.? Each dropper is metered to allow for accurate dosing every single time. RISE CBG tincture does not contain any nut oil, is made with hemp seed oil (refined/golden) to offer a 100% cannabis-based tincture.
